Name: `CODEC2_LEVEL`
Description: Set [debug.stagefright.ccodec](https://cs.android.com/search?q=debug.stagefright.ccodec) property for level of Codec2 ranking on codecs list.
Notes:
Explanation of each values can be seen in [Codec2InfoBuilder.cpp](https://github.com/BlissOS/platform_frameworks_av/blob/typhoon-x86/media/codec2/sfplugin/Codec2InfoBuilder.cpp#L400). Set `0` if you want to disable Codec2 to only use OMX.
**WARNING:** This option is deprecated and is being removed in BlissOS 16+.

Name: `OMX_NO_YUV420`
Description: Disable YUV420 planar for all OMX codecs. Unset to re-enable YUV420 planar for OMX.
Notes: **WARNING:** This option is deprecated and is being removed in BlissOS 16+.

Name: `FFMPEG_CODEC2_PREFER`
Description: Set FFMPEG Codec2 as default. Unset to disable.
Notes: **WARNING:** This option is deprecated and is being removed in BlissOS 16+.

Name: `FFMPEG_CODEC2_DRM`
Description: Enable DRM Prime Handle on FFMPEG Codec2. Unset to disable.
Notes: Can be used to improve performance when using FFMPEG Codec2. Currently this option is considered WIP and can only being used on some hardware with `minigbm` gralloc used and supports YUV.

Name: `FFMPEG_CODEC2_DEINTERLACE_VAAPI`
Description: Set FFMPEG Codec2 deinterlace mode when using hw-accelerated video decoding.

Name: `FFMPEG_OMX_CODEC`
Description: Enable FFMPEG OMX. Unset to disable.
Notes: **WARNING:** This option is deprecated and is being removed in BlissOS 16+.

Name: `FFMPEG_CODEC_LOG`
Description: Enable logging for FFMPEG codecs. Unset to disable.
Notes: Can be used on both Codec2 & OMX.

Name: `FFMPEG_HWACCEL_DISABLE`
Description: Disable hardware acceleration on FFMPEG codecs. Unset to re-enable.
Notes: Can be used on both Codec2 & OMX.
